business_summary: Japan Data Science Consortium Co.Ltd., engages in the development and licensing of algorithm modules utilizing machine learning and other technologies business in Japan. The company operates through three segments: AI solutions business, financial advisory business, and marketing support business. The company provides Wodom!, a data infrastructure construction services; learning insight; home insight, a home IoT that solves social issues, such as nursing care prevention and reduction of absentee deliveries; demand insight, an AI solution that prevents stockout and overstock, and semi-automates ordering operations; and maintenance insight, an AI solution that realizes remote monitoring, anomaly detection, and operation optimization of manufacturing equipment and home appliances. It is also involved in the development and operation of IT systems; technical services; and data science advisory and consulting business. In addition, the company offers demand forecasting, inventory optimization, and order automation solutions; marketing optimization solutions; communication tools for pharmaceutical and medical device companies; examination preparation materials; agricultural data solutions; and electricity data analysis for local government frailty detection services. Japan Data Science Consortium Co.Ltd. was founded in 2013 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.
